name: Discover Discolike Companies
runs_on: a saved DiscoLike query (Query ID on the launch row); it runs the discovery again on that query's stored domains, every page. A DiscoGen-approved set is its own saved thin_* query and is launched by that id
reads: the query's answers; the held Companies at those domains; the DNC table
creates: nothing of its own: the register's 20 columns must exist; a custom key in the pull is created as a column and its People lookup
held_value: overwrite on a new pull (DiscoLike is fresher); Domain Source on create only; Tag re-stamped
providers: DiscoLike; no credential or a dead API is a logged skip, the row closes Failed with the reason
logs: the launch row only: pulled, landed (new, refreshed), emails, columns created, skips, failures
handoff: Enrich Contacts, once, on Companies view Not Sourced scoped to this pull's domains
